doc.title: Lanny Morgan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999

title: Saxophone section and personnel of the Ferguson band
summary: He names the saxophonists in the band and the order of tenors.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: don’t think it was ever that again. And Maynard’s band was on the rise and it was a hot band and it just kept getting better and better. And so many guys went through that band. You know the saxes when I joined were Frank Hittner was playing baritone and Joe Farrell was playing tenor and Willie and myself. Slide Hampton was on the band quite a bit off and on, Jackie Byard, and then a lot of other guys came through the band too at different times.
Were you there when Don Menza came through?
Yeah. Don replaced Joe Farrell. It was Joe and then Menza and then Frank Vicari was the third tenor player. And then the band broke up, not because of that, but shortly after that.
